gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Paprika arrives with commanding, widely scattered letters whose lowercase fills the line like capitals, hollow and expressive. Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified without growing.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supple: Hollow, reed-like counters give Paprika its commanding, expressive voice. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement answers in sans-serif, its round forms like open parentheses under a middle band so tall the lines look stocky.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Tangsa, yet Paprika brings the commanding, expressive swagger of letters scattered at a distance. They feel like a shout and a welcome.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu reads in a professional, neutral way, with a high-set midline and counters connected to the outside. But Paprika is the one for commanding, expressive display, its lowercase filling the line like capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-vai: Big, scattered, and expressive: that is Paprika, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Noto Sans Vai quietly makes words read as solid blocks in sans-serif, with generous space between curve ends and stem.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Paprika commands attention with scattered, expressive letters, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. But Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps things clean and modern, with open throats on a, c, e and s.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-oxygen: Counters like a hollow reed cut open make Paprika unmistakable, commanding and expressive. Oxygen follows in sans-serif, curves never closing back on themselves, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans reads crisp and modern, with one stroke thickness and wide-mouthed letters. Paprika, expressive and commanding, lets lowercase fill the line like capitals above it.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-prompt: Paprika is all swagger, scattered and commanding. Its lowercase fills the line like capitals, while Prompt does the quieter job, with an oversized look to its small letters and open apertures that read easily.
